880-2374-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-2374-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Maja triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

728-4681-5170-8175.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat.

147-1854-3967.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1854-3967.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

539-728-3249-5457--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-3249-5457--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Selvala triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

339-677-728-5434.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3899-7173.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3899-7173.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

880-3470-7885.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Lotus Cobra and Down in the Valley trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3488-3899-4552-7824.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Katsumasa.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

5641-6823-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5641-6823-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

1257-1671-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1257-1671-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

457-1329-2981-7340.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Sewer-veillance Cam, adding {U}.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Sewer-veillance Cam.
Sewer-veillance Cam triggers, untapping a creature you control.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.
457-1329-2981-7340.notes: If you control an artifact creature, it can be untapped by the second Sewer-veillance Cam trigger, and then tapped via Urza to get infinite blue mana. Once you have infinite blue mana, you can either use it for Urza's second ability and/or to activate Sewer-veillance Cam's ability to draw cards.

4217-6709-7101.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
4217-6709-7101.description:
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Ballad of the Black Flag.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Ballad of the Black Flag.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

284-997-6972--112.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Angel of Invention.
When Angel of Invention dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Angel of Invention enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
284-997-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Angel of Invention's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

3259-5734-6968.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control other than Death Tyrant.
3259-5734-6968.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any creature you control except Death Tyrant, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Death Tyrant triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

3375-3532-5078-6607.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lorescale Coatl triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-620-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
392-620-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yotian Dissident.
Repeat.

2511-2866-3518-4986.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

3705-4050-6026-6896.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Field of Souls triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

1350-1669-2793-6871.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Toph triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

511-817-3921-4050-6705.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Frog and a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Frog and Saproling, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1652-5626-6580.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
You have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
1652-5626-6580.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Patron of the Arts and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Patron of the Arts dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

856-2292-5631-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

974-3750-5446.notablePrerequisites:
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
An opponent cannot block and kill Esika's Chariot.
974-3750-5446.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Esika's Chariot's crew ability by tapping the Smaug token, causing Esika's Chariot to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Esika's Chariot as an attacker.
Esika's Chariot's second ability triggers, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat from step 4.
974-3750-5446.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may copy any other token(s) you control instead.

2457-4094-4289-4359.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2457-4094-4289-4359.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

440-1339-1939-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-1939-5231.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
When the Insect dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve the Lunarch Veteran // Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

413-2781-5987.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it if necessary.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Felidar Guardian and tapping it.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Angel of Indemnity.
When Angel of Indemnity enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger untapping it
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

372-1809-3306.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1809-3306.description:
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Returned Pastcaller and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Returned Pastcaller trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Slip On the Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Returned Pastcaller and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

2034-3470-4826-5552.notablePrerequisites:
Archelos is untapped.
You control at least ten permanents.
2034-3470-4826-5552.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ojer Kaslem, adding {C}{C}.
When Ojer Kaslem dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Temple of Cultivation and untapped due to Archelos.
When Temple of Cultivation enters the battlefield, Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Temple of Cultivation's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, transforming Temple of Cultivation into Ojer Kaslem.
Repeat.

1844-1972-4691.notablePrerequisites: Your deck size is at least nine.
1844-1972-4691.description:
Cast Fateful Handoff by paying {3}{B}, causing you to draw eight cards and give control of Vilis to an opponent.
During that opponent's draw step, they draw a card.
Nekusar triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 until the opponent loses the game either due to drawing from an empty library, or from having 0 life.

1286-2034-4679.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one Aura on the battlefield attached to a creature you control.
Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
1286-2034-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of any Aura you control attached to any creature you control, then causing you to untap Yenna and scry 2.
Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token, then attaching the Aura token to the Cat.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Cat, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1046-1168-1479.notablePrerequisites: You have a basic Forest in hand.
1046-1168-1479.description:
Play a basic Forest card from your hand.
Kodama and Toggo trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Holding priority, activate the basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a Rock equipment artifact token.
When the Rock token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate Living Twister's second ability by paying {G}, returning the Forest from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting the Forest onto the battlefield from your hand.
When the Forest enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

224-1359-2366-4050-5220.notablePrerequisites: You are abile to play a land this turn.
224-1359-2366-4050-5220.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding one mana of any color.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Dryad Arbor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger from step 2, causing you to scry 1, ensuring to leave Dryad Arbor on top of your library.
Galadriel's second ability triggers, causing you to reveal Dryad Arbor from the top of your library, and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

2102-2186-3206.notablePrerequisites: Manascape Refractor does not have summoning sickness.
2102-2186-3206.description:
Activate Manascape Refractor using Faceless Haven's second ability by paying {S}{S}{S}, causing Manascape Refractor to become a 4/3 creature with all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Manascape Refractor using Griffin Canyon's second ability by tapping it, untapping Manascape Refractor and giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 2.

1429-2034-2775-2850.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-2034-2775-2850.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding {C}{C}.
Lesser Masticore dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Slimefoot by paying {4}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Ivy Lane Denizen, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
The Saproling dies, triggering Slimefoot, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1324-3499-4191.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one creature on the battlefield.
1324-3499-4191.description:
Cast Ovinomancer by paying {0}.
Ovinomancer enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability.
Holding priority, activate Ovinomancer's second ability by tapping it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, destroying target creature and causing its controller to create a 0/1 Sheep creature token.
Resolve the Ovinomancer trigger from step 2, choosing not to return any lands to your hand.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1472-2232-2530-3265-4190.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least four.
1472-2232-2530-3265-4190.description:
Cast Dockside Chef by paying {B}.
Tatsunari triggers, creating a 3/3 Keimi legendary creature token.
Keimi enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Carnival of Souls.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Dockside Chef enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Carnival of Souls.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Hateful Eidolon from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Cast Hateful Eidolon by paying {B}.
Keimi triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Hateful Eidolon enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Carnival of Souls.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Dockside Chef from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Cast Dockside Chef by paying {B}.
Keimi triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 6.

380-2232-3593-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonartifact Dragon creature card in hand.
380-2232-3593-4050.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting any Dragon from your hand onto the battlefield.
The Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Miirym.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a token copy of the Dragon.
The token Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning the nontoken Dragon from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Dragon token, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1929-2275-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Oracle's Insight attached to Famished Paladin.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
1929-2275-3957.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to draw a card.
When you draw a card, Shabraz will trigger, gaining you 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Gaining the life untaps Famished Paladin.
Repeat.

4740-5089.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink.
Your life total is at least 51.
4740-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Aetherflux Reservoir to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target and causing you to gain 50 life.
Repeat step 3.
